title: Playtest: run seed (layout, item offers, rerolls, extra picks) + Settings seed row
description: Implemented 2026-11-19 (RunSeedService, SeedSettingsView, F8 / PrintSeed debug). Compiled with 0 errors, never playtested. Verify: same seed + same picks => same floors/offers; reroll doesn't shift later screens; Settings seed copy/Play works; restart gives a new seed.

title: Playtest: goose stretch tension sound follows aim pull
description: PlayerSoundManager plays 'stretch' (2.0Tension.wav, 2.5s) looped on a dedicated AudioSource from DragStarted; volume 0.3->1 and pitch 0.9->1.3 follow pull (drag/MaxForceMagnitude), unscaled time; 0.08s fade on release/cancel. Compiles. Check: loop seam when holding >2.5s (may need a seamless loop clip), tune Stretch ranges/curve in inspector.

title: Playtest: enemy hit loudness scales with damage / health share
description: EnemyHealth plays damageEnemy via AudioManager.PlayOneShotWithGain. Loudness 1.0 (normal) -> 1.35 (heavy). Heaviness = max(damage 20->40, share of starting health 10%->35%). Compiles (offline Roslyn check 2026-11-23). Verify by ear that gain >1 actually amplifies (AudioSource.PlayOneShot volumeScale). Optional follow-up: same scaling for killEnemy sound.

title: Boss intro: stand still for an intro animation before acting
description: Add a start spawn delay to boss enemies so they stand still at the start for an intro animation. User plans to write this themselves in a separate script.

title: Cannon.OnDrawGizmosSelected has an inverted guard
description: Returns when _rotatingParts has items, then dereferences _rotatingParts[0] (Cannon.cs ~line 146). Editor-only gizmo; should be 'if (_rotatingParts is not { Count: > 0 }) return;'.

title: Cleanup: ItemPickBonusSystem is an unused duplicate of Reroll/ExtraPick systems
description: Scripts/Items/ItemPickBonusSystem.cs is not referenced by any script, prefab or scene. Confirm and delete.

title: Cleanup: dead fields/methods in ProjectilePrediction
description: _needsRecalculation is write-only, _dragChangeThreshold (const) unused, SimulateFromCurrentState() is dead since the adaptive-stepping change (Scripts/Player/ThrowTrajectory/ProjectilePrediction.cs).
